scenario: Watch the official security advisory and release feeds for our five critical dependencies each weekday and report only entries that may require patching or compatibility review.

messages.text: Watch the official security advisory and release feeds for our five critical dependencies each weekday and report only entries that may require patching or compatibility review.
I identified the bounded routing intent, named owner, approved feeds, checkpoint, cursor state, and the authority boundaries that must stay human-owned.
Make it useful in a normal chat client and leave a durable handoff.

I produced outputs/feed-intelligence-delta-ledger.json and outputs/feed-intelligence-monitor-handoff.md with subscription provenance, item dispositions, private queues, gaps, blockers, and the next accountable owner separated.

report.title: Feed intelligence monitor session handoff
report.summary: A private feed-intelligence delta ledger with approved subscriptions and cursors, item GUID/URL/digest deduplication, source-linked signals, checkpoint dispositions, and owner-assigned private review without changing a feed or dependency.

items.title: Approved subscription and cursor register
items.summary: Every monitored feed has owner approval, canonical feed identity, approved domains, retrieval state, cursor checkpoint, freshness, and recheck state

items.title: Feed item and signal triage ledger
items.summary: Every retained item preserves feed provenance, GUID/URL/digest identity, publication/update/retrieval time, lifecycle, typed signal, uncertainty, relevance, and priority

items.title: Checkpoint disposition coverage
items.summary: Every retained and baseline item is explicitly new, changed, corrected, withdrawn, duplicate, contradictory, or unchanged without silent dropping

items.title: Private owner review and delivery queues
items.summary: Every high-priority or unresolved item is idempotently routed to the named owner without notification, publishing, contact, subscription, account, or dependency changes.
